notes.title: Mac update
notes.content: MacOS version should now work properly

notes.title: Chapter 2 Bug fix
notes.content:
With the release of chapter 2, the Guiding Professor took a small break, which introduced other problems. However, now that he is back, he brought in other changes:
- The dog's woof in the laboratory is now appropriate for localization.
- The buildings and clue-giving characters are now easier to recognize.
- The tablets in the factories now give more information about what is going on.
- There is now a boss at the large factory.
- The player sometimes had to interact twice with certain things, but now may only do it once.

notes.title: RELEASE OF CHAPTER 2 - DETECTIVELAND
notes.content:
Chapter 2 is now released. Embark on a mission to discover the mystery of the Death Cult and save Detectiveland!

- New playable story
- Localization improvements
- Performance updates

notes.title: Patch Notes for March 11
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
- The bonfires that indicate how to progress the dungeons of Kristerra should now correctly change colour.

Balance Fixes:
- Road Guards of Kristerra now have only 1 goblins accompanying them.

Features:
- Added Credits option in the Title Menu. Players can open this menu to see the credits and click on their websites to learn more about developers.

notes.title: LOCALIZATION UPDATE
notes.content:
Game Tester Quest now has full Turkish support!
Added Turkish translations for the following:
- Terms
- States
- Weapons
- Armours
- Items
- Characters
- Conversations
- Messages
- Menu controls

Added enemy health bars for improved combat experience.

Added health and damage optimizations for all enemies.
